# Finance metrics (semantic layer)

Source of truth: the semantic layer tables (`apps/cap/db/semantic.cds`, seed in `apps/cap/db/data`). Every result records the metric version it used (for example `total_revenue@v1`).

> A metric runs in **pilot** and **production** only with an APPROVED, effective version (and approved dependencies). In **mock** and **local** (synthetic data) a PENDING_REVIEW version may run so development works before Finance sign-off (decision D-02). REJECTED, RETIRED and DRAFT versions never run.

Gross recognised revenue in the accounting period from sales and services.

## `profit_margin` — Profit Margin (%)
